note: The arcade as bodies in space (MAIL 1010, MAIL 1029 point 2 and 3). Lengths are stage units (the ball's radius is terrain.json radius), angles degrees, speeds stage units a second along the strand. Every strand is a fixed line; what moves is the plasma along it, at one steady speed for each strand. least: the least half width of a strand in pixels of the buffer, below it the strand keeps that width and its light falls by the same share. thin: over this range of a strand's true half width against least (0.45 down to 0.15) its light goes from the line of a tube to one soft bell over its whole band, with the same sum across in linear light. light sheath: how many times the tube's width the thin sheath around it is wide, and its light against the tube's. light cool and hot: the colour of a faint and of a bright strand as the finished frame shows it, in linear light. leave under: where the ball is not in the depth buffer (the far Sun draws the arcade in a pass without depth) a strand behind a ball this far under the true radius, as the eye sees it, gives no light. main unlike: the ten bundles are of unlike size, a strand takes bundle floor(x to this power times 10) for x from 0 to 1. main spread wide: a bundle is as wide as spread times this, the largest bundle the first value, the smallest the second. main loose: a strand of no bundle has this share of the radius and of the light.
